key: This hub uses an older type of Bluetooth that does not work in any browser on iPhone or iPad.
en: This hub uses an older type of Bluetooth that does not work in any browser on iPhone or iPad.
translation: Deze hub gebruikt een ouder type Bluetooth dat in geen enkele browser op iPhone of iPad werkt.

key: An unexpected error occurred. Please consider reporting this so we can make a better error message. Click the {copyErrorMessage} button below to copy the technical details and paste it in the bug report. Also include the operating system you are using, the web browser you are using and the actions you performed that led to this error.
en: An unexpected error occurred. Please consider reporting this so we can make a better error message. Click the {copyErrorMessage} button below to copy the technical details and paste it in the bug report. Also include the operating system you are using, the web browser you are using and the actions you performed that led to this error.
translation: Er is een onverwachte fout opgetreden. Klik hieronder op {copyErrorMessage} om de technische details te kopiëren voor een foutrapport, en vermeld daarbij je besturingssysteem, browser en wat je deed toen de fout optrad.

key: Could not connect to the hub.
en: Could not connect to the hub.
translation: Kon geen verbinding maken met de hub.

key: Check that your hub is not in use by other apps.
en: Check that your hub is not in use by other apps.
translation: Controleer of je hub niet al door een andere app wordt gebruikt.

key: Check that your hub is not in use by other apps. Make sure that you have permission to connect.
en: Check that your hub is not in use by other apps. Make sure that you have permission to connect.
translation: Controleer of je hub niet door andere apps wordt gebruikt en of je toegangsrechten hebt om te verbinden.

key: Failed to connect to update server. The internet connection or the server may be down. Try again later.
en: Failed to connect to update server. The internet connection or the server may be down. Try again later.
translation: Kan geen verbinding maken met de updateserver. Controleer je internetverbinding of probeer het later opnieuw.

key: This browser does not support Web Bluetooth or it is not enabled.
en: This browser does not support Web Bluetooth or it is not enabled.
translation: Deze browser ondersteunt geen Web Bluetooth of de functie is uitgeschakeld.

key: Use a supported browser such as Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
en: Use a supported browser such as Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
translation: Gebruik een ondersteunde browser zoals Google Chrome of Microsoft Edge.

key: On Linux, Web Bluetooth must be turned on manually.
en: On Linux, Web Bluetooth must be turned on manually.
translation: Op Linux moet Web Bluetooth handmatig worden ingeschakeld.

key: Brave turns off Web Bluetooth. To turn it on, paste the line below into the address bar, set it to {enabled} and restart Brave.
en: Brave turns off Web Bluetooth. To turn it on, paste the line below into the address bar, set it to {enabled} and restart Brave.
translation: Brave schakelt Web Bluetooth standaard uit. Plak onderstaande regel in de adresbalk, zet deze op {enabled} en herstart Brave:

key: No Bluetooth adapter could be found or permission to use it has not been granted.
en: No Bluetooth adapter could be found or permission to use it has not been granted.
translation: Geen Bluetooth-adapter gevonden of er is geen toestemming verleend om deze te gebruiken.

key: Please connect or enable a Bluetooth Low Energy adapter, ensure your browser has permission to use it and restart the browser.
en: Please connect or enable a Bluetooth Low Energy adapter, ensure your browser has permission to use it and restart the browser.
translation: Schakel een Bluetooth Low Energy-adapter in, geef je browser toestemming voor Bluetooth en herstart de browser.

key: Some browsers like Brave and Opera do not support Web Bluetooth. Be sure to use a supported browser such as Chrome, Edge or on iPhone and iPad, Bluefy.
en: Some browsers like Brave and Opera do not support Web Bluetooth. Be sure to use a supported browser such as Chrome, Edge or on iPhone and iPad, Bluefy.
translation: Sommige browsers zoals Opera ondersteunen geen Web Bluetooth. Gebruik Chrome, Edge, of Bluefy op iPhone en iPad.

key: The web browser did not give permission to use Bluetooth Low Energy.
en: The web browser did not give permission to use Bluetooth Low Energy.
translation: De webbrowser heeft geen toestemming gegeven voor Bluetooth Low Energy.

key: Failed to connect to the hub.
en: Failed to connect to the hub.
translation: Verbinding maken met de hub is mislukt.

key: Please restart your computer and the hub, then try again.
en: Please restart your computer and the hub, then try again.
translation: Start je hub en je computer opnieuw op en probeer het nogmaals.

key: How can I solve connectivity issues?
en: How can I solve connectivity issues?

key: Connected to hub but failed to get {serviceName} service.
en: Connected to hub but failed to get {serviceName} service.
translation: Verbonden met de hub, maar de service {serviceName} kon niet worden geopend.

key: Ensure that you are using the most recent firmware.
en: Ensure that you are using the most recent firmware.
translation: Zorg ervoor dat je de nieuwste firmware gebruikt.

key: If the problem persists, try removing the "{hubName}" device in your OS Bluetooth settings, then try connecting again.
en: If the problem persists, try removing the "{hubName}" device in your OS Bluetooth settings, then try connecting again.
translation: Blijft het probleem bestaan, verwijder dan "{hubName}" uit de Bluetooth-instellingen van je besturingssysteem en verbind opnieuw.

key: Have you installed the Pybricks firmware yet?
en: Have you installed the Pybricks firmware yet?
translation: Heb je de Pybricks-firmware al op de hub geïnstalleerd?

key: A new firmware version is available for this hub. Please install the latest version to use all new features.
en: A new firmware version is available for this hub. Please install the latest version to use all new features.
translation: Er is een nieuwe firmwareversie beschikbaar voor deze hub. Installeer de nieuwste versie om alle functies te gebruiken.

key: The connected hub uses a newer Pybricks communication profile version. Some features may not work correctly.
en: The connected hub uses a newer Pybricks communication profile version. Some features may not work correctly.
translation: De verbonden hub gebruikt een nieuwer Pybricks-communicatieprofiel. Sommige functies werken mogelijk niet goed.

key: Downgrade the hub firmware or upgrade {app} to avoid problems.
en: Downgrade the hub firmware or upgrade {app} to avoid problems.
translation: Werk {app} bij of installeer bijpassende hub-firmware om problemen te voorkomen.

key: The hub is no longer connected. Please reconnect and try again.
en: The hub is no longer connected. Please reconnect and try again.
translation: De verbinding met de hub is verbroken. Verbind opnieuw en probeer het nogmaals.

key: The file '{fileName}' could not be opened. It is already open in another window.
en: The file '{fileName}' could not be opened. It is already open in another window.
translation: Het bestand '{fileName}' kon niet worden geopend omdat het al in een ander venster geopend is.

key: There are no files to back up. Create a new file first by clicking the {icon} icon.
en: There are no files to back up. Create a new file first by clicking the {icon} icon.
translation: Er zijn geen bestanden voor een back-up. Maak eerst een nieuw bestand via het pictogram {icon}.

key: There were no {py} files in the {zip} file.
en: There were no {py} files in the {zip} file.
translation: Er zijn geen {py}-bestanden gevonden in het {zip}-bestand.

key: A USB error occurred while installing the firmware.
en: A USB error occurred while installing the firmware.
translation: Er is een USB-fout opgetreden tijdens het installeren van de firmware.

key: Ensure the USB cable is not damaged and is firmly attached to the hub and to the computer.
en: Ensure the USB cable is not damaged and is firmly attached to the hub and to the computer.
translation: Controleer of de USB-datakabel niet beschadigd is en stevig in zowel de hub als de computer zit.

key: This browser does not support WebUSB or WebUSB is not enabled.
en: This browser does not support WebUSB or WebUSB is not enabled.
translation: Deze browser ondersteunt geen WebUSB of WebUSB is uitgeschakeld.

key: This browser does not support WebHID or WebHID is not enabled.
en: This browser does not support WebHID or WebHID is not enabled.
translation: Deze browser ondersteunt geen WebHID of WebHID is uitgeschakeld.

key: Hub not found. Make sure that the hub is connected via USB and that it is in update mode.
en: Hub not found. Make sure that the hub is connected via USB and that it is in update mode.
translation: Hub niet gevonden. Zorg dat de hub via USB is aangesloten en in de updatemodus staat.

key: Also make sure that you have permission to connect.
en: Also make sure that you have permission to connect.
translation: Controleer ook of je de juiste USB-toegangsrechten hebt ingesteld.

key: The firmware you selected is not compatible with your hub.
en: The firmware you selected is not compatible with your hub.
translation: De geselecteerde firmware is niet geschikt voor jouw hub.

key: This is very unusual. The USB device did not contain the expected interface.
en: This is very unusual. The USB device did not contain the expected interface.
translation: Ongebruikelijke fout: het USB-apparaat bevat niet de verwachte interface.

key: You may release the power button on the hub now.
en: You may release the power button on the hub now.
translation: Je kunt de aan/uit-knop op de hub nu loslaten.

key: This program is too big. Compiled size is {actual} bytes but the hub can only fit {max} bytes.
en: This program is too big. Compiled size is {actual} bytes but the hub can only fit {max} bytes.
translation: Dit programma is te groot: de gecompileerde grootte is {actual} bytes, maar op de hub past maximaal {max} bytes.

key: Try removing unused code or making names and strings smaller.
en: Try removing unused code or making names and strings smaller.
translation: Verwijder ongebruikte code of maak tekstreeksen korter.

key: This browser does not support the Web Serial API or it is not enabled.
en: This browser does not support the Web Serial API or it is not enabled.
translation: Deze browser ondersteunt de Web Serial API niet of deze staat uit.

key: This hub is already in use in another Pybricks tab or window.
en: This hub is already in use in another Pybricks tab or window.
translation: Deze hub is al in gebruik in een ander Pybricks-tabblad of -venster.

key: Not connected. Make sure that the hub is on. Then try again.
en: Not connected. Make sure that the hub is on. Then try again.
translation: Niet verbonden. Controleer of de hub aan staat en probeer het opnieuw.

key: You have to register the connection manually the first time.
en: You have to register the connection manually the first time.
translation: De eerste keer moet je de Bluetooth-verbinding handmatig registreren.

key: Pybricks is not yet installed on this hub.
en: Pybricks is not yet installed on this hub.
translation: Pybricks staat nog niet op deze hub geïnstalleerd.

key: Address copied to clipboard. Use a wallet that supports ENS addresses to donate.
en: Address copied to clipboard. Use a wallet that supports ENS addresses to donate.
translation: Adres gekopieerd naar klembord. Gebruik een wallet met ENS-ondersteuning om te doneren.

key:
Connected to hub but failed to get {serviceName} service.
Ensure that you are using the most recent firmware.
If the problem persists, try removing the "{hubName}" device in your OS Bluetooth settings, then try connecting again.
en:
Connected to hub but failed to get {serviceName} service.
Ensure that you are using the most recent firmware.
If the problem persists, try removing the "{hubName}" device in your OS Bluetooth settings, then try connecting again.
translation:
Verbonden met hub, maar service {serviceName} kon niet worden opgehaald.
Zorg dat je de nieuwste firmware gebruikt.
Verwijder anders "{hubName}" in de Bluetooth-instellingen van je systeem en verbind opnieuw.

key: Unexpected error while trying to connect: {errorMessage}
en: Unexpected error while trying to connect: {errorMessage}

key: Failed to initialize file storage. Changes will not be automatically saved.
en: Failed to initialize file storage. Changes will not be automatically saved.
translation: Kan bestandsopslag niet initialiseren. Wijzigingen worden niet automatisch opgeslagen.

key: The hub took too long to respond. Restart the hub and try again.
en: The hub took too long to respond. Restart the hub and try again.
translation: De hub reageerde niet op tijd. Herstart de hub en probeer het opnieuw.

key: There was a problem with Bluetooth.
en: There was a problem with Bluetooth.
translation: Er is een probleem opgetreden met Bluetooth.

key: The hub was disconnected before installation was completed. Restart the hub and try again.
en: The hub was disconnected before installation was completed. Restart the hub and try again.
translation: De verbinding met de hub werd verbroken voordat de installatie klaar was. Herstart de hub en probeer opnieuw.

key: The hub said something went wrong.
en: The hub said something went wrong.
translation: De hub meldde dat er iets misging.

key: The connected hub is not supported.
en: The connected hub is not supported.
translation: De verbonden hub wordt niet ondersteund.

key: The firmware is for a different kind of hub from the connected hub.
en: The firmware is for a different kind of hub from the connected hub.
translation: De gekozen firmware is bedoeld voor een ander type hub dan de verbonden hub.

key: Failed to fetch firmware from the server: {status}
en: Failed to fetch firmware from the server: {status}
translation: Ophalen van firmware van de server mislukt: {status}

key: The firmware.zip file is missing required files or is invalid.
en: The firmware.zip file is missing required files or is invalid.
translation: Het bestand firmware.zip is ongeldig of mist vereiste bestanden.

key: The firmware.metadata.json file contains missing or invalid entries. Fix it, then try again.
en: The firmware.metadata.json file contains missing or invalid entries. Fix it, then try again.
translation: Het bestand firmware.metadata.json bevat ontbrekende of ongeldige velden. Herstel dit en probeer opnieuw.

key: The included main.py file could not be compiled. Fix it, then try again.
en: The included main.py file could not be compiled. Fix it, then try again.
translation: Het meegeleverde bestand main.py kon niet worden gecompileerd. Herstel de fout en probeer opnieuw.

key: The combined firmware and main.py are too big to fit in the flash memory.
en: The combined firmware and main.py are too big to fit in the flash memory.
translation: De gecombineerde firmware en main.py passen niet in het flashgeheugen van de hub.

key: Unexpected error while trying to install firmware: {errorMessage}
en: Unexpected error while trying to install firmware: {errorMessage}
translation: Onverwachte fout bij het installeren van firmware: {errorMessage}

key: A new version of {appName} is available. Click {action} to start using the new version.
en: A new version of {appName} is available. Click {action} to start using the new version.
translation: Er is een nieuwe versie van {appName} beschikbaar. Klik op {action} om de nieuwe versie te starten.

en: Switch UI & block language (Python code is never modified).
translation: Wijzig de taal van de interface en programmeerblokken (Python-code blijft ongewijzigd).
